HADESANCIENTS-ARCTIC_GALE.title: Arctic Gale
HADESANCIENTS-ARCTIC_GALE.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{OrbSlots}[/blue] Orb Slots. Whenever you play a Power card, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{FrostToChannel}[/blue] [gold]Frost[/gold] and deal [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-ARCTIC_RING.title: Arctic Ring
HADESANCIENTS-ARCTIC_RING.description: The first time each turn you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Skills, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] times the number of Skills played this turn to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-COLD_STORAGE.title: Cold Storage
HADESANCIENTS-COLD_STORAGE.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Preserve[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}. You may [gold]Preserve[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} at rest sites.
HADESANCIENTS-FRIGID_RUSH.title: Frigid Rush
HADESANCIENTS-FRIGID_RUSH.description: At the start of each turn, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your draw pile. Whenever you draw a [gold]Status[/gold] card, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-FROSTY_VENEER.title: Frosty Veneer
HADESANCIENTS-FROSTY_VENEER.description: You cannot lose more than [blue]{MaxHpLoss}[/blue] HP in a single turn.
HADESANCIENTS-ICE_STRIKE.title: Ice Strike
HADESANCIENTS-ICE_STRIKE.description: Your Attacks apply [blue]{ChillToApply}[/blue] [gold]Chill[/gold] on every hit.
HADESANCIENTS-PLENTIFUL_FORAGE.title: Plentiful Forage
HADESANCIENTS-PLENTIFUL_FORAGE.descripti: Whenever you gain a combat reward, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. After each combat, gain an additional card reward and a random [gold]Potion[/gold] reward.
HADESANCIENTS-STEADY_GROWTH.title: Steady Growth
HADESANCIENTS-STEADY_GROWTH.description: After each combat, you may [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{CardsToUpgrade}[/blue] {CardsToUpgrade:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. After every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, you may [gold]Enchant[/gold] [blue]{CardsToEnchant}[/blue] {CardsToEnchant:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Steady[/purple].
HADESANCIENTS-SNOW_QUEEN.title: Snow Queen
HADESANCIENTS-SNOW_QUEEN.description: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{MaxHpLossPercent}%[/blue] Max HP. Start each combat with [blue]{BufferPower}[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold] and [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-TRANQUIL_GAIN.title: Tranquil Gain
HADESANCIENTS-TRANQUIL_GAIN.description: The first time each combat you end your turn with at least [blue]{EnergyThreshold}[/blue] unspent Energy, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of each turn for the rest of combat.
HADESANCIENTS-WEED_KILLER.title: Weed Killer
HADESANCIENTS-WEED_KILLER.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into [gold]Weed Out[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-WINTER_HARVEST.title: Winter Harvest
HADESANCIENTS-WINTER_HARVEST.description: Enemies with [blue]{HealthThreshold}%[/blue] Max HP or less shatter at the start of their turn. Whenever a creature dies, deal damage equal to its Max HP to ALL enemies.
